title: Krea 2 · Character
blurb: A person or character, photoreal. Trains only Krea 2's mid-block MLPs (blocks 8-21): 3x smaller and faster, previews on Krea 2 Turbo in 8 steps.
notes: Causal layer-masking ablation on Krea 2 showed facial identity concentrates in mid blocks 8-21 (0.761 vs 0.126 early 0-8, 0.279 late 18-27) and MLPs (0.763 vs 0.177 attention).

Validated on 37 photos (plain flow matching, 1,000 steps): LoKr factor 8 on mid-block MLPs (blocks 8-21, 132 MB vs 375 MB full LoKr) with Automagic3 + adapter geometry at 3e-4 (lr_floor 0.5, EMA 0.98) reached 0.253 likeness at 250 steps, 0.629 at 500, 0.722 at 750 and 0.737 at 1000 (against 0.075 / 0.260 / 0.460 / 0.645 for plain Automagic3 on the same layers, with faster median opt_ms: 9.5 vs 9.9 ms). With SparseID enabled, the same setup reaches 0.829-0.831 at 1000 and 0.856-0.862 at 1250.
